**Estate**: 18 ha; 11 Cabernet Franc, 7 Chenin Blanc; clay and flint soils.
**Output**: 62,000 bottles average; 48,000 in 2024 after May hail cut a fifth of western plots.
**Certification**: Organic since 2019; biodynamic conversion began 2023; earliest certification 2026.
**Export**: 41% of sales, mainly Belgium and Japan; Japanese importer requires sulphites under 60 mg/l.
**Failures**: 2022 tank 4 controller drifted 3°C for two days; bulk loss 11,000 euros.
**Controls**: Controllers calibrated pre-harvest; tank 4 has second probe.
**Labels**: 2023 printing error recalled 900 bottles; proofs need two signatures.
**Irrigation**: Banned on western plots; 2021 trial cut acidity below Japanese limit.
**Harvest**: Dates set from sugar and acidity over three consecutive mornings, never calendar.
**Fermentation**: Tanks above 28°C cooled within four hours.
**Pending**: Lighter bottles proposed 2025; importer unconfirmed, no cost comparison.
**Pending**: Eastern parcel replanting after 2027 undecided; vines 54 years, yields down 30% in five years.
